laidiesVoice.evidenceRequired: The reader is treated as capable; the writing is adult, practical, funny where earned and never corrective or condescending.

analogyIntegrity.evidenceRequired: The work-life and AI mirror clarifies the mechanism, states where the analogy stops and is removed when it adds no practical value.

usefulnessDepth.evidenceRequired: The reader can use the result in a real situation and knows when AI can help, when a person must decide and when professional escalation is appropriate.

formatFit.evidenceRequired: Daily cards stay brief; the parent lab contains the full rehearsal and a durable artifact; Library and episode links serve distinct jobs.

searchIndexing.evidenceRequired: Accepted parent content is indexed for the real workplace problem and the related AI principle; held derivatives remain suppressed.

relationshipLinking.evidenceRequired: Each item links to the narrowest accepted parent with a stated payoff and typed relationship reason.

canonConsistency.evidenceRequired: Context, memory, prompting, receipts and human-judgement explanations agree with current episodes, classes, books and NewsStand content.

songOpportunity.evidenceRequired: Each batch records no-fit or a distinct mnemonic opportunity; career guidance does not automatically commission a song.

derivativeFeeds.evidenceRequired: Only an accepted public parent may unlock a source-bound Daily item; correction, expiry or parent hold suppresses the derivative.

accuracy.evidenceRequired: Names, relationships, buildings, events and any AI principle agree with accepted canon and current learning content.

antiSlop.evidenceRequired: Each thread has a distinct comic premise, character-specific voice and an ending; no generic meme dialogue or filler banter.

currentBestPractice.evidenceRequired: Any product behavior used in an AI joke is current or intentionally timeless and has a correction trigger.

laidiesVoice.evidenceRequired: The humour is warm, sharp and Rewind Era-aware without becoming childish, cruel or borrowed from the reference creator.

analogyIntegrity.evidenceRequired: An AI-linked thread reinforces one accepted principle without turning every joke into a lesson; pure comedy may remain pure comedy.

usefulnessDepth.evidenceRequired: A learning thread leaves one memorable correction and points to a complete parent; continuity and comedy threads have an honest world-building job.

formatFit.evidenceRequired: The thread is legible at mobile width, clearly fictional, short enough for Daily and supplied with an accessible linear transcript.

searchIndexing.evidenceRequired: Only accepted canonical columns enter NewsStand/search; fictional dialogue is labeled and never indexed as resident testimony or factual reporting.

relationshipLinking.evidenceRequired: AI-linked threads point to the exact accepted lesson; town threads point only to a real accepted event, building or character destination.

canonConsistency.evidenceRequired: A preflight checks character voice, relationships, chronology, location and collision with KSVL story-song or Overheard formats.

songOpportunity.evidenceRequired: The pilot records no-fit or hands a genuinely musical premise to KSVL as a separate original work order; Town Group Chat is not automatically a song.

derivativeFeeds.evidenceRequired: Only the accepted canonical thread may generate a social derivative; rejected scripts and private or real-user content remain suppressed.
